name: vLLM
summary: High-throughput PagedAttention LLM serving engine prized for lightning-fast batching and long-context RP over multi-GPU setups.
ranking_rationale: Delivers industry-best token throughput and rock-solid OpenAI-compatible RP APIs (trade-off: best suited to Linux NVIDIA GPUs rather than quick Windows consumer setups).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Delivers industry-best token throughput and rock-solid OpenAI-compatible RP APIs
Handles giant 32K–128K character lorebooks smoothly on heavy VRAM rigs
cons: Best suited to Linux NVIDIA GPUs rather than quick Windows consumer setups
Heavier memory footprint than single-user llama.cpp
